description.text:
SM Chinese Promos holds the promos of the Simplified Chinese game's Sun & Moon years, numbered NNN/SM-P beside a PROMO mark. They began with the game itself on 28 October 2022: players at certified Pokémon card gyms (宝可梦卡牌道馆) got a gym event special pack (道馆活动特别包) holding one random gym promo, and some of that first wave could be played only once later products were out. A second wave followed in February 2023 to mark the second product. The gym promos carry a Pokémon TCG Gym mark, as 001 to 012 and 019 to 030 do. In November 2022 Pokémon China noted that the free event promo Chespin, 014/SM-P, calls it the Mouse Pokémon instead of the Spiny Nut Pokémon; the card stayed legal and was not replaced.

The first big tournaments added prize cards. At the 2023 Masters in Guangzhou in March every player got a pack with one of three promos, open-division players with five or more qualifier wins got Rare Candy, as did the top eight, and the top four, the runner-up and the champion also got a Victory Decoration (胜利勋章) marked for Guangzhou 2023. The Super events in Qingdao and Wuhan that spring gave Great Ball, marked with the place, to their top 64. From 15 April to 14 July 2023 every player in the 300 King's Battles of Battle Party (对战派对 王者争夺赛) got The Masked Royal, and each champion a holo one, 300 in all. 050 Rowlet carries the mark of the Shanghai Library. Our list numbers the cards 001 to 050; the prize cards have no number.

Top 4, 2nd Place and Champion copies went to the top four players of each division, alongside a Rare Candy for their place. This Champion copy went to each division's winner.
